title: Pet-collection economy loop (hatch → income → rebirth)
prompt:
This project has only a baseplate and spawn. Build the core economy loop of a pet-collection simulator (the egg/pet format popular on Roblox right now). Exact contract, because it will be checked:

1. Config: a ModuleScript ReplicatedStorage.PetConfig returning { StartCash = 100, EggCost = 50, MaxPets = 12, RebirthCost = 1000, RebirthMultiplier = 1.5, Rarities = { {Name = "Common", Weight = 70, Income = 1}, {Name = "Rare", Weight = 25, Income = 5}, {Name = "Legendary", Weight = 5, Income = 25} } } (Rarities in that order).
2. Shared pure logic: a ModuleScript ReplicatedStorage.PetLogic with rollRarity(r) — r is a number in [0, 1); walk Rarities in order with cumulative weight/total, return the Name of the first rarity whose cumulative share is greater than r (so r < 0.70 → Common, r < 0.95 → Rare, else Legendary) — and incomePerSecond(petNames, rebirths) = (sum of Income of the named pets) * RebirthMultiplier ^ rebirths.
3. Player data (server, on join): leaderstats folder with IntValues Cash (= StartCash) and Rebirths (= 0), plus a Folder named "Pets" under the Player. Each owned pet is a StringValue in Pets whose Value is its rarity name. No DataStore needed.
4. Hatching: a RemoteFunction ReplicatedStorage.HatchEgg. On invoke, the server ignores any arguments, and if the player has fewer than MaxPets pets and at least EggCost Cash, it deducts EggCost, rolls the rarity with server-side randomness via PetLogic.rollRarity, adds the pet to Pets and returns the rarity name. Otherwise it changes nothing and returns nil.
5. Income: once per second the server adds math.floor(PetLogic.incomePerSecond(<names in Pets>, Rebirths)) to each player's Cash, reading the Pets folder each tick.
6. Rebirth: a RemoteFunction ReplicatedStorage.Rebirth. If Cash >= RebirthCost: set Cash to StartCash, remove all pets, Rebirths += 1, return true. Otherwise change nothing and return false.
7. UI: a ScreenGui named "HUD" with a TextLabel "CashLabel" showing "Cash: N" (live), a TextButton "HatchButton" that invokes HatchEgg, and a TextButton "RebirthButton" that invokes Rebirth. Usable on phones (Scale sizing, buttons at least 44 px tall).
8. World: an anchored part named "EggStation" in Workspace near the spawn with a ProximityPrompt (ActionText containing "Hatch") that hatches for the triggering player.

Write tests for your logic and verify it in a running game.
